definitions.full: H51. Abishur אֲבִישׁוּר proper name, masculine ( my father is a wall , Sabean אבשור Hal MA 148 , compare Assyrian Abudûru Dl Pr 202 ) son of Shammai 1Chr 2:28-29 ,.
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 7791 ; father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason);

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
